claims.label: PROVED_PENDING_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW
claims.exact_statement: Let q_n be +1 only at the origin and -1 elsewhere, let D_n be its complete physical selector packet D=L+Q, and Gamma_n^D=D_n-D_(n-1)/2. Put C_n=2^n D_n. For every 2<=t<n, reveal n-t predetermined physical data coordinates and stop on the unique exceptional branch at q_t. Then the total reached negative credit is sum_(m=t+1)^n 2^(m-n)(-Gamma_m^D)=2^-n(C_t-C_n), and D_n plus this debt equals the single expected terminal packet 2^(t-n)D_t=2^-n C_t. Moreover C_n decreases to 4, so the debt is at most (C_2-4)2^-n<0.8677*2^-n and consumes less than 0.1783 of the terminal packet. Every credit and the terminal packet are used once.
hypotheses: complete conditional-label plus phase packet D=L+Q

dependencies.role: contributor-proved phase and full-packet negativity; fresh review pending

retires_for_declared_family: Negative first full-packet credits necessarily accumulate without a bounded nonlocal refund.
The q_n rare logarithm must be discarded into a pointwise O(I) charge.
does_not_prove: a terminal packet bound by total influence for arbitrary Boolean functions
a near-tensor or addressing refund theorem
